newsitem.title: CANADA: Ukraine says Russia must let it be independent.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine says Russia must let it be independent.

text.p: Russia must fully come to terms with the fact that Ukraine is independent, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Hennady Udovenko said on Wednesday.

"They need to change their mentality and understand that Ukraine is an independent country," Udovenko told the National Press Club during a two-day visit to Canada. He said it could take years to change the Russian mindset.
Ukraine became independent in 1991 and has struck a foreign policy line distinct from Russia's.
Udovenko said that during talks with Canadian Foreign Minister Lloyd Axworthy on Wednesday he would pursue his country's goal of a partnership agreement between Ukraine and the NATO Western alliance.
The minister -- who will also visit central Canada, home to numerous Ukrainian immigrants -- invited foreign investment.
He said Ukraine could absorb U.S.$30 billion to $40 billion in foreign investment to restructure industry. Since independence, Ukraine has attracted only $1.4 billion in private foreign investment.
